verdict.rationale: FreeAgent is accounting SaaS rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server. The documented OAuth 2.0 REST API is only a developer building block that someone could use to build one, so it earns no credit, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
